job.prompt:
Create an extremely difficult endless 2D runner through a colorful enchanted forest.

I control a little woodland fox who automatically sprints forward. Pressing Space makes the fox jump.

I want an intense precision-based experience with fast movement, short reaction windows, dangerous combinations of gaps and spikes, rapid consecutive jumps, and challenging obstacle patterns.

Difficulty should escalate significantly as I survive, but every obstacle sequence must remain physically possible.

Use detailed animated forest scenery and parallax backgrounds.

Track my distance and allow instant restart when I crash.

events.detail: Interpreting central loop, controls and constraints
Planning validated arcade controls and survival loop
Composing seeded obstacle stream and selected movement controller
Checking typed movement bounds, scoring and obstacle configuration
Registered canvas runtime and bounded procedural stream ready
